name: Gemhold
author: DansiDanutz
summary: Take turns placing blocks on a field of gems. Hold more of two colours than the other player.

choices.label: Hard
choices.note: Rocks stand on the field. No block may cover one.

howto: Take turns placing blocks. Your first block covers your own corner; every later one touches your ground by a side.
The first block of a game is small: one to three cells, depending on the board.
When nobody can place a block, each gem colour goes to the player who holds more of it. Most colours win, then most gems, then the player who went second.
